title: Puerto Rican musicians: Escudero and Fernando Arbello
summary: After a break Jones names the musicians he worked with in Puerto Rico.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Now, you've been down to Puerto Rico and you did the Eight Doors.
Paul Nevers on the piano, and a bass player because of bringing that you know so much and so well.../Juan Tizol up to New York. Escudero ... [Bob Escudero]
Did he play bass in Puerto Rico?
He played in the trio that I opened up with. /There's another great Puerto Rican musician that's down there, a trombone player.
Oh, Arbello. He's with Don Redman, oh yes, of course. (Fernando Arbello, trombonist)
